hooks.text: 五个夜晚躲在会展安保室里，一边等伪造票打印，一边处理缺墨和保险丝熔断。
hooks.excerpt: Throughout five nights, you must remain hidden within the convention center security office as the printer churns away at your prized possession. You'll have to micromanage the printer and deal with mechanical issues such as the ink running out or the fuses bursting.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 卷帘门和灯光会持续耗电，电力耗尽或偶像机偶先找到你都会让守夜失控。
hooks.excerpt: Be careful to conserve power, as the shutters and lights use electricity, and the convention center is strict about power usage within the security booth. And if you run out of power -- or if your oshis find you before you have your ticket...?
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 为了见虚拟主播偶像，玩家闯入漫展伪造门票，却被高科技偶像机偶提前“见面”。
hooks.excerpt: The only way you'll be able to meet your oshis at Dweebcon is by breaking into the convention center and counterfeiting a ticket. Y'know, as one does. You have the ticket file and the best printer in the world; all it will take is one good print of the ticket.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
